notes.en: Reviewed on retained evidence. one actual retained passing run of skillHubWebappTestingGuestAndBrowserQualification() (Apple Swift Testing, 1 passed / 0 skipped; the XCTest 'Executed 0 tests' summary line is interpreted separately, never as the pass) at App source 0fb7b6a86840dd52b10e7ce64812bf9b851fed1b, compiled test file sha256 0f8c50b3aed499f2b04e5439e9cba44175f08c135ec1ab2385ba50c22c3a92ff, Xcode 27.1 (27A9275), iOS 27.0 Simulator, real RISC-V Linux guest with the qualified kernel (uname 6.18.56) asserted in-run. The run staged the frozen 15-file source tree whose every file was re-verified byte-equal against these exact package bytes at review time (archive e01f62bf3895fc78467036effdbf41838e1e875877c900ea8006d73089c247af). In-run proofs with fail-closed assertions: guest staging re-hash bad=0; guest py_compile of all three shipped scripts; exec.localService dynamic fixture server on an owned loopback port with previewURL accepted only in the recorded running state across every retained poll; authoritative-clean guest /state before the contract; the full 14-case runbook contract through the real browser.* tools — typed values verified in returned snapshots, the 12-hex page receipt read through on-device OCR then cross-attested against the guest server /state authority, an independent server counter attestation, the screenshot artifact bytes read back from disk with byte-count and sha256 equality, main-frame navigation commits via documentID change, stale-ref refusal surfacing the documented recovery message plus fresh-observation recovery (both halves mandatory), the SLOW-DONE-45 late result over the guest loopback paired with browser.events, and the deliberate honest absent-marker TIMEOUT negative recorded through the shipped recorder; the shipped check_fixture.py gate exited 0 with at least 14 CHECK PASS lines and read the failing case honestly; the native JSONL read-back decoded all 14 records and asserted every per-record status (13 PASS plus the TIMEOUT/FAIL negative) before printing the sha256 of the exact JSONL bytes, ddbf3433db196ca4c319507658835391f4118b440733563a82c2b727b41e8a91, which matches the retained log. Lifecycle: a deliberate live port collision failed closed naming the port conflict; two-layer jobs.status inspection (state running plus the owned previewURL); jobs.cancel settled to terminal cancelled with the previewURL absent in the final progress document and the endpoint proven dead from both the host and inside the guest. Retention limits, stated as limitations and never regenerated: the original 14-row JSONL was not archived (the successful workspace was cleaned); its in-run digest and per-record assertions are the evidence, and the runbook's 'retain results JSONL' evidence-packet step is therefore only partially satisfied. Context honesty: the same retained batch preserves the unrelated seven-art-new-diagnostic FAIL (exit 65) and an earlier webapp-case FAIL at App source 36de1d65 that this passing source repaired; no algorithmic-art claim is made here. Runbook Level B+C executed in the real App on a Simulator — not model inference, not a physical device, not App acceptance, not a production claim.
notes.zh-Hans: 一次真实保留的通过运行 skillHubWebappTestingGuestAndBrowserQualification()（Apple Swift Testing，1 通过 / 0 跳过；XCTest『Executed 0 tests』汇总行单独解释，绝不当作通过），App 源码 0fb7b6a86840dd52b10e7ce64812bf9b851fed1b，编译测试文件 sha256 0f8c50b3aed499f2b04e5439e9cba44175f08c135ec1ab2385ba50c22c3a92ff，Xcode 27.1（27A9275），iOS 27.0 模拟器，真实 RISC-V Linux 客户机且在运行内断言合格内核（uname 6.18.56）。该运行装入工作区的冻结 15 文件源码树在审阅时逐文件与本记录绑定的包字节重新核对为完全一致（归档 e01f62bf3895fc78467036effdbf41838e1e875877c900ea8006d73089c247af）。运行内失败即断言的证明：客户机 staging 重哈希 bad=0；客户机内 py_compile 三个随附脚本；exec.localService 动态夹具服务运行于自有回环端口，且在每个保留轮询样本中 previewURL 仅在记录的 running 状态被接受；契约开始前客户机 /state 权威干净；完整 14 案例 runbook 契约经真实 browser.* 工具执行——输入值在返回快照中验证、12 位十六进制页面回执经设备端 OCR 读出后与客户机服务器 /state 权威交叉证实、独立的服务器计数证实、截图产物字节从磁盘读回并做字节数与 sha256 相等校验、主框架导航提交经 documentID 变化证明、陈旧 ref 拒绝呈现文档化恢复信息并完成重新观察恢复（两半都必须发生）、经客户机回环取得 SLOW-DONE-45 迟到结果并配合 browser.events、以及通过随附记录器诚实记录故意缺席标记的 TIMEOUT 负例；随附 check_fixture.py 门禁以退出码 0 通过，至少 14 行 CHECK PASS 且诚实读取失败案例；原生 JSONL 读回解码全部 14 条记录并逐条断言状态（13 条 PASS 加 TIMEOUT/FAIL 负例），随后打印该 JSONL 精确字节的 sha256 ddbf3433db196ca4c319507658835391f4118b440733563a82c2b727b41e8a91，与保留日志一致。生命周期：故意的在线端口冲突失败关闭并指明端口冲突；jobs.status 双层结构检查（state running 加自有 previewURL）；jobs.cancel 落定终态 cancelled，最终进度文档中 previewURL 缺席，且宿主与客户机两侧均证明端点已死。保留限制（如实陈述为限制，绝不补造）：原始 14 行 JSONL 未归档（成功工作区已清理）；其运行内摘要与逐条断言即为证据，因此 runbook『保留结果 JSONL』的证据包步骤仅部分满足。上下文诚实：同一保留批次中保存了无关的 seven-art-new-diagnostic 失败（exit 65），以及在 App 源码 36de1d65 上更早的 webapp 案例失败（由本次通过的源码修复）；此处不作任何 algorithmic-art 声明。Runbook Level B+C 在模拟器上的真实 App 中执行——非模型推理、非物理设备、非 App 验收、非生产声明。
